title: XOR translations preserve cube sums
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $F:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $c\in\{0,1\}^n$. Write $z\oplus c$ for coordinatewise addition modulo two. Then $\sum_{z\in\{0,1\}^n}F(z\oplus c)=\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}F(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: The dimension $n$ is a natural number
$F$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
$c$ is a Boolean vector of dimension $n$
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $F\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $c\in\{0,1\}^n$, with $\oplus$ denoting coordinatewise addition modulo two. Then $\sum_{z\in\{0,1\}^n}F(z\oplus c)=\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}F(x)$.
